methods.what: Value of log(2K/π) in previous case as log term plus 2πi times sum of differences of sawtooth functions
Series expansion of log(2K/π) at x = mπ/n (n even, m odd) using roots of unity α = e^{2πi/4n}
Representing 1/(4nt+s) via integral and finite Fourier expansion of (α^{2ms}-1)/(α^{2ms}+1) in sawtooth functions
Final Dedekind-sum-type formula for case 2 with inverse μ of m mod 2n
Final formula for case 3, x = mπ/(2n), with μ inverse of m mod 4n
